# Lightweight Workflow

Use when there is no brief setup.

## Workflow

1. Clarify the smallest useful outcome.
2. Identify project files the engineer should read first.
3. Define allowed write areas in plain language.
4. Define validation commands.
5. Keep the handoff short enough to paste into an assistant.

## Output

- goal
- relevant files
- allowed edits
- validation
- next step
